description: HTTP engine on the BigQuery REST API: projects and datasets as the project and schema levels, tables paged with pageToken (tables, an external table and a view), epoch-millisecond creation times, columns from each table (REQUIRED and REPEATED modes), dataset access entries of every grantee kind as grants (an authorized view without a role included), and the job history as usage with the failed job's reason as its status. Incremental: the second run asks for jobs from the watermark (minCreationTime, through the toEpochMs filter) and gets the boundary job again, which is not emitted twice.
